verdict.rationale: The only evidence touching this axis is a single generic marketing bullet claiming 'Built-in pipeline monitoring and alerts' with no elaboration on table freshness metrics or cadence-miss alerting, and no docs page, dashboard, or independent corroboration describing how staleness or missed schedules are surfaced. Missing for 10: documentation of freshness/staleness tracking per destination table, concrete alerting mechanism for missed cadence, and any community/hands-on confirmation of this feature working.
